name: binding-bring-enhancement-compare
description: Re-runs the T vs ³He f-factor comparison with pn_convention='bring_color_weighted' to test whether the substrate-pure δ = Δm/M_N at q_0 closes the 15% single-magic A=3 p/n asymmetry. Per the audit docs/audits/2026-05-31-binding-magic-A-wireup.md.
computation: closed_form_ratio(Z, N, q_0, pn_convention) compared across 'strict_averaged' and 'bring_color_weighted'; f required to close B_endo to B_AME under each.
f_spread_summary: T vs ³He f-factor spread (single-magic A=3 p/n asymmetry): strict_averaged = 4.79%, bring_color_weighted = 4.79%. The Bring weighting at q_0 produces a substantially identical f-spread — the 180.9 ppm uniform correction cancels out of the T vs ³He ratio because both have exactly one pn arc. The 15%+ T vs ³He spread is at the arc-COMPOSITION layer (T = pn+nn vs ³He = pp+pn, distinct factors f_nn ≠ f_pp), NOT at the pn-arc weighting layer; Bring weighting cannot close it. The actual closure path is the operator-valued Wenzl branching with full per-arc operator extracts (canonical_tr_m_via_branching.py + A_operator_extract_at_level.py), not a scalar pn-weighting refinement.
